message.content:
The current screen shows the Clipper app with a notification that "Clipper service is started." and instructions for copying to clipboard using ADB shell. To copy the text "john.doe@example.com" to the clipboard, I need to open the Markor app, enter the text in its editor, long-press the editor to select it, and then use the clipboard copy command. The first step is to launch the Markor app.


do(action="Launch", app="markor")
